name: openwa-worker
description: WhatsApp gateway for Cloudflare Workers — baileys in a Durable Object, a REST + WebSocket API, and a WhatsApp Web-style UI.

API_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for the REST API and the events WebSocket. Strongly recommended in production: leave it unset and anyone with the worker URL can read and send messages. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

UI_PASSWORD.description: Password for the browser login. Falls back to API_TOKEN when unset. Rotating it signs every browser out.

SESSION_TTL_HOURS.description: Optional. How long a browser login stays valid, in hours. Default 168 (7 days), max 720.

IDLE_TTL_MS.description: Optional. How long one wake keeps the WhatsApp socket open, in milliseconds (5000–900000). Default 60000.

DAILY_WAKE_LIMIT.description: Optional. Connects allowed per session per UTC day before the API returns 429. Default 300; 0 disables the cap.

INBOUND_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. POST inbound messages here as JSON.

INBOUND_WEBHOOK_TOKEN.description: Optional. Bearer token sent with inbound webhook deliveries.

scripts.test: node --test scripts/patch-baileys-worker-socket.spec.js scripts/patch-baileys-link-preview.spec.js scripts/auth.spec.mjs scripts/cursor.spec.mjs scripts/settings.spec.mjs scripts/tokens.spec.mjs scripts/outbox.spec.mjs
